walkthroughs.body_html: Food security means everyone has reliable access to enough safe, affordable food. Climate change, war and supply shocks threaten it globally. Diversifying crops, supporting local growers and cutting waste all build resilience.

Overfishing has emptied many fisheries. The MSC blue label (Marine Stewardship Council) signals seafood from a fishery managed within sustainable limits. Choosing certified fish keeps options open for the future.

A circular food system minimises waste at every step — compost food scraps, recycle packaging, redistribute surplus through charity schemes. Some advocate GM food to raise yields with fewer inputs; others worry about long-term effects.
